payload.abstract: Neuro-degenerative disease often affects gait and mobility. To understand better the pathophysiology of these diseases and to improve our ability to measure responses to therapeutic interventions, it may be helpful to quantify gait dynamics accurately. The records in this database are from patients with Parkinson's disease (n = 15), Huntington's disease (n = 20), or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (n = 13). Records from 16 healthy control subjects are also included here.

payload.short_description: Database of force-sensitive resistors (with the output roughly proportional to the force under the foot) from patients from Parkinson's disease (n=15), Huntington's disease (n=20), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (n=13), and healthy subjects (n=16).
payload.title: Gait in Neurodegenerative Disease Database
